governingRule: Official government sites only. Each topic answers to whoever owns that topic: Borough President's office questions to the BP's office, day-to-day city services to NYC 311 and the responsible city agency, state matters to New York State. No blogs, news articles, forums or search snippets treated as fact. If no listed source covers a question, fall back to the Borough President's HelpLine instead of answering from model memory.

policy: Adding a source takes a deliberate admin edit and, in production, the Borough President's office sign-off. The chatbot may only search, fetch and cite sources on this list.
